item.title: CfgMgmtCamp 2027 Black Friday Sale
item.description:
The exceptional Black Friday sale for CfgMgmtCamp 2027 is open!

Tickets are 100% off. Yes, that means FREE. Get them at registration.cfgmgmtcamp.org while you can.

The schedule will be published within the next 2 weeks.

See you in Ghent, 1-3 February 2027.

item.title: Cfgmgmtcamp 2027
item.description:
We are halfway 2026 already so it is time to think about what you will be doing next February.

Start with blocking your calendar for 1-3 February . As usual we’ll be meeting in Ghent for 3 days of Infrastructure Automation Geekery. It will be a fun mix of 2 days of conference with new and old communities, followed by a day of workshops hackathons and tutorials. You know you can’t mis this.

item.title: A long overdue report of DevopsDays
item.description:
Here’s how it started :

So I used to be a software developer, writing perl for the web, then C, then Java, then PHP, till I realized nobody ever configured my servers correctly and I changed trades becoming a system engineer, while teaching new developers the basics of their trade, whom grew into doing Infrastructure Architecture .. familiar story for much of the crowd at DevopsDays … a crowd that wants to stopping the war between developers and system engineering , a crowd that wants to automate builds, integrate testing, deploy, deploy on very large scale, deploy in the cloud and much more.
